statement: The exact reference material the recreated workbench must reproduce. Two captured views of one capability, plus the viewer template, stylesheet and runtime that produced them.

products.note: Restored topology products served by the website.

capability.title: Convergently author an SDA capability candidate from canonical source authority
capability.note: Both captured views belong to this one capability. They are two baselines, not conflicting definitions of one graph.

zoomStateDerivation: The fitted scale at this layout is well below the 0.35 threshold, so the loader would have opened this view at 70%.
A displayed 15% is therefore a Fit diagram result reached after load, not the load default.
Reproducing 15% exactly requires the drawing viewport to measure about 1005 x 630 CSS px; at 975 px it rounds to 14%.
This derivation must be confirmed by measuring a running instance during M1.

expected.label: Execution · Admit the capability authoring context

capture.selection: captured selected elements and trace classes were present in the pasted DOM
zoomStateDerivation: 25% is neither this view's fitted scale nor the 70% load default at the screenshot viewport.
It is a user-reached camera state, consistent with zoom-out steps or a narrower viewport.
Browser-added attributes and transient trace tokens in that capture are artifacts, not UI authority.
The pasted DOM itself is not retained in this workspace; only the facts it established are recorded here.

materials.note: Content-addressed material images referenced by the captured scenes. Only the textures the two fixtures reference are frozen.

ingestionPolicy.note: The plan requires scripts, event handlers and unapproved external references to be rejected when a legacy SVG is consumed as a scene artifact.
